novel_features.name: Compound message evidence
novel_features.description: Find messages using participant, dates, direction, literal text and attachment evidence together.
novel_features.rationale: Account-scoped local joins combine messages, participants and attachment metadata across mirrored threads.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a concrete question needs a bounded intersection of message facts.

novel_features.name: Message-anchored context packet
novel_features.description: Retrieve neighboring messages around a known message, including collection boundaries.
novel_features.rationale: Local message ordering and provenance create a bounded evidence packet around one stable source ID.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after finding an exact message when its surrounding exchange matters.

novel_features.name: Question-scoped coverage evidence
novel_features.description: See freshness, unfinished pagination and collection failures before relying on a lookup.
novel_features.rationale: Folder inventory, thread checkpoints and run failures must be joined with the proposed lookup scope.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before treating an empty search as evidence that no communication occurred.

novel_features.name: Observed conversation activity
novel_features.description: See observed inbound and outbound counts and latest message times per conversation.
novel_features.rationale: Local direction and time aggregates join exact participants and collection observations without assigning relationship meaning.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to establish recent communication facts before a separate skill interprets them.

novel_features.name: Newly mirrored records
novel_features.description: Inspect which records collection added, keeping old backfill distinct from recent communication.
novel_features.rationale: Immutable first-seen collection observations join source timestamps and stable message IDs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to review collection growth and confirm repeated imports do not invent new arrivals.

narrative.headline: Read Google Voice through ordinary HTTP and recover evidence from a local message mirror.
narrative.value_prop: Collect account-scoped message history with resumable pagination, then search it locally. Inspect surrounding conversation, observed activity and collection coverage before answering from that history.
narrative.auth_narrative: Google Voice uses an existing signed-in Google web session, not a consumer API key. Import credentials from a private local HAR with auth import-har; the CLI keeps only allowlisted session material in a machine-local profile and computes SAPISIDHASH for each fixed-host read request. Expired sessions require a fresh private import; a running browser is not required for ordinary reads.

quickstart.comment: Check command configuration without credentials or network.
Verify the imported profile identifies the expected Voice account.
Collect a bounded amount of message history and persist continuation work.
Find literal matches in the local message mirror.
Inspect observation freshness and unfinished collection before using the result.

troubleshoots.symptom: Google returns 401 or the session is no longer usable.
troubleshoots.fix: Capture a fresh signed-in Voice read HAR privately, import it with auth import-har, then run auth status --live.

troubleshoots.symptom: A search is empty or older messages are missing.
troubleshoots.fix: Run mirror coverage, then mirror sync with bounded --max-pages to continue pending inventory or thread history; an empty result is not completeness proof.
Honor the reported retry time and rerun bounded mirror sync later; do not install a rapid polling loop.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for read-only Google Voice account, conversation and message access and for deterministic queries over its local mirror. Check collection coverage when answering a question from missing or older history. Keep relationship judgment and cross-service person identity in separate tools.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to send SMS/MMS, reply, call, mark read, archive or delete source conversations.
Do not use this CLI to merge identities or modify the existing Signal/Telegram relationship-memory database.
Do not use this CLI to install a background service or promise complete Google Voice history from one bounded sync.
